home.title: Pharaohs Lab
home.lead: Public data, honest uncertainty. Every figure shows its sample size and its source.
home.no_next: No upcoming fixture found in the data.
home.elo_odds: Elo-based odds (win / draw / loss for Egypt)
home.elo_note: From pre-match Elo ratings with a fitted draw rate; a simple model, not a bookmaker price.
home.xi_note: Top goalkeeper plus ten outfield players by start probability under Hossam Hassan. The opponent is not an input. Interval is 80%.
home.formation_note: Probability for this opponent's Elo band and venue. Intervals are 90% and wide because the samples are small.
home.baseline: Baseline: same formation as the last match
home.baseline_honest: In backtests the baseline beat the model: {base} exact hits vs {model} for the model (n = {n}). For the next match, assume the baseline is the better guess.
home.f_coach_text: {p} matches since {from}: {w} W, {d} D, {l} L ({ppg} points per game). Formation model hit rate {model} vs {base} for repeating the last formation (n = {n}); the model loses.
home.f_salah_text: Egypt took {with} points per game with Salah in the XI (n = {nw}) vs {without} without (n = {nwo}); the difference is {diff} with a 95% interval of {lo} to {hi}, so it is not clearly different from zero. Salah is not absent at random, so this is not a causal estimate.
home.f_diaspora_text: {n} documented lead(s) for scouts. A lead list, not a statement of eligibility.
home.f_opp_text: {n} upcoming and recent opponents profiled, with Elo odds, head-to-head, form and typical line-ups.
home.f_load_text: {flagged} of {total} players in the latest window squad carry at least one load flag. The backtest covers {n} past player-window rows; read its caveats before drawing conclusions.
home.xi_n: n = {n} test matches in the XI backtest

coach.title: Coach: Hossam Hassan
coach.lead: Egypt head coach since February 2024. Everything here is derived from FotMob lineups and events and cross-checked against Wikipedia.
coach.record_note: Shootouts are counted as draws; see the reconciliation note for how that differs from Wikipedia.
coach.formations_note: Starting formation as recorded by FotMob; in-match changes are not in the data. Intervals are 90% credible intervals.
coach.continuity_note: Number of starters who were not in the previous match's XI.
coach.core_note: Players with the most starts under Hassan, and where his starters play their club football.
coach.subs_note: Median minute of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd+ substitution, and what kind of change it is.
coach.tactical_note: Paraphrased from public reports. Not a complete scouting record.
coach.honesty: The formation model does not beat a trivial baseline. Predicting that Egypt repeat the previous match's formation was right {base} of the time vs {model} for the model (n = {n} test matches, each predicted from earlier matches only). Treat the formation probabilities as a description of tendencies, not as a forecast better than 'same as last time'.
coach.xi_pred: Predicted XI for a next match
coach.xi_bt: XI backtest: starters correct out of 11
coach.xi_bt_note: The XI model beats the 'same XI as last match' baseline on average, but with wide spread across matches.

salah.title: Salah succession
salah.lead: Two questions: how much does Egypt depend on Mohamed Salah, and who could take over his role? Both rest on small samples.
salah.dependency: Does Egypt do worse without Salah?
salah.confounders: Confounders: why this is not causal
salah.marmoush: Salah x Marmoush since Hassan's start
salah.roles_note: Cosine similarity of percentile profiles over eight features, among Egypt-eligible players. Similarity ignores level, so read it with the output index.
salah.board_note: Rules combine similarity, output, age, minutes and a league tier. The league tier is an analyst judgement, so the board below can be switched between the two readings.
salah.tier2_note: With the Egyptian league at tier 2, these names move into the groups shown. Only names are recomputed; detail rows come from the default run where available.
salah.low_conf_note: Scored on goals and assists per 90 only (fewer than four trait percentiles). Never placed in 'ready now'.
salah.not_found_detail: no detail row in the default run

diaspora.title: Diaspora scout
diaspora.lead: Players with an Egyptian link who play abroad, found in public sources and ranked by squad need. Documented leads only.
diaspora.position_need_note: Need score per position group from minutes and age of the current regulars.
diaspora.rule_note: A plain-language summary of the cited FIFA documents, not legal advice. Whether a given player may switch is decided by FIFA's Players' Status Committee.
diaspora.method_text: Candidates are found through public lists: Wikipedia categories of people of Egyptian descent who play football, Egypt youth squads, and Wikidata citizenship and birthplace fields. Each lead keeps the sentence and URL that justify it. The score combines positional need for Egypt (from our own minutes and age data), age, how well the club and caps were verified, and league level when known; the weights used are shown on each card. Senior caps for another nation mark a player as likely ineligible and remove him from the list. Youth caps are shown as a caveat. Players already capped by Egypt are excluded.
diaspora.no_private: Only documented public information is shown.

opp.title: Opponents
opp.lead: One card per upcoming or recent opponent: fixture, Elo odds, history, form, typical line-up and style.
opp.sb_outdated: Possibly outdated: from AFCON 2023 only, before squad and coach changes.

sp.title: Set pieces
sp.lead: How Egypt score and concede from corners, free kicks and penalties. Coverage is partial, and every number carries its own sample.
sp.coverage_global: Coverage warning: situation labels (corner, free kick, open play) exist only for matches with a FotMob shot map. All figures below are lower bounds or small samples.
sp.sb_outdated: From AFCON 2023 only (four Egypt matches). Possibly outdated.

load.title: Load tracker
load.lead: Club minutes, rest and travel before each international window. A screening list, not an injury predictor.
load.board_note: Sorted by combined score (0 to 7). Flags that cannot be evaluated count as zero.
load.travel_note: Route length per player from the club city through each venue. A map is not shown because coordinates are not part of the published data.
load.backtest: Backtest: do flags relate to minutes played?
load.backtest_note: Rows are player-windows. Outcome is the share of window minutes played. Selection bias applies: only players called up are visible.

meth.title: Methodology and sources
meth.lead: What we use, how we fetch it, what is missing, and how to tell us when we are wrong.
policy_items: All requests go through one client with a descriptive User-Agent that names this site.
At least two seconds between requests to the same host, with an on-disk cache and exponential backoff.
A 401/403 or challenge page stops that source. We never spoof headers, rotate proxies or use headless browsers.
We store only what the analysis needs and publish derived and aggregated figures, never raw feeds.
StatsBomb open data is used with its attribution; raw events are not republished.

meth.error_text: Open an issue on GitHub with the page, the number and what you expected.
meth.stats_text: Intervals are 90% credible intervals from a Beta(1,1) prior unless stated. Small samples give wide intervals, and wide intervals are the honest answer. Models are backtested against simple baselines and the results are shown even when the baseline wins.
